review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-023 defines functional software behavior for notifying the pilot upon reception of a fleet message. The requirement has a clear subject ('The SFMC'), a well-defined trigger ('when a new fleet message is received'), and an explicit action ('notify the pilot'). There are no vague degree words, placeholder responses, undefined categories, or escape clauses present. It does not represent a safety interlock, inhibit, or hazard mitigation, so SWE-184 is not applicable.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-023 specifies software behavior requiring the SFMC to notify the pilot when a new fleet message is received, meeting quality standards without demonstrated defects.
